macros.name: AddSpotColor
macros.doc: The \AddSpotColor macro should be used to introduce a new spot color.

macros.name: NewSpotColorSpace
macros.doc: The \NewSpotColorSpace command should be used to define a new color space for spot colors.

macros.name: SpotSpace
macros.doc: Macro \SpotSpace is used to introduce blanks in names.
